svg.title: REGAIN: regulatory representation-guided accessibility imputation
svg.desc: Panel a. A revision of the supplied two-level REGAIN schematic. Sparse peak-by-cell measurements are transformed into the TF-IDF fitting target Y. ChromBERT supplies a fixed peak embedding E. W denotes the learnable shared projection and H the learnable cell coefficients. Their alternating optimization fits the target Y while E remains fixed. Z=EW maps E into dataset-specific peak topics. The fitting relationship is Y≈ZH and the imputed matrix is Ŷ=ZH=EWH. The notation change introduces no change to the model or its constraints. E has P by d entries, W d by K, Z P by K, H K by C, and Ŷ P by C. All heatmaps, signal tracks and cell embeddings are illustrative, not experimental results. The paired observed and imputed cell embeddings show the same 42 stylized cells with the same three color identities, arranged to communicate clearer clustering. Other applications are candidate cCRE recovery and developmental regulation.
